epistemic_note: These are Human Design doctrine archetypes for blind prediction/classification. They are not empirically established behavioral facts. Jovian Archive is used for the official mechanics; secondary references are used to cross-check the complete 36-channel naming inventory.

channels.label: Inspiration
channels.construct: distinctive creative self-expression that becomes a contribution or example for others

channels.label: The Beat
channels.construct: directing sustained life-force and resources toward an internally felt direction

channels.label: Mutation
channels.construct: periodic transformation and new beginnings emerging through limitation and uncertainty

channels.label: Logic
channels.construct: doubt-driven search for logical, testable patterns and workable answers

channels.label: Rhythm
channels.construct: strong recurring rhythms, routines, timing patterns, and adjustment to extremes

channels.label: Intimacy
channels.construct: breaking interpersonal barriers to create intimacy, bonding, and close partnership

channels.label: Alpha
channels.construct: guiding collective direction through recognized or selected leadership

channels.label: Concentration
channels.construct: capacity to become still and sustain narrow focus on detail

channels.label: Awakening
channels.construct: spontaneously expressing self-directed behavior and identity in the present

channels.label: Exploration
channels.construct: self-empowered action that follows one's own convictions and direction

channels.label: Perfected Form
channels.construct: intuitive present-moment behavior oriented toward personal survival and correctness

channels.label: Curiosity
channels.construct: collecting ideas and experiences and turning them into stimulating stories or explanations

channels.label: Openness
channels.construct: mood-dependent social and emotional expression with strong timing sensitivity

channels.label: Prodigal
channels.construct: listening to and remembering experience, then retreating and selectively sharing its lessons

channels.label: Wavelength
channels.construct: developing mastery through depth, practice, repetition, and refinement

channels.label: Acceptance
channels.construct: organizing logical opinions into precise facts and communicable detail

channels.label: Judgment
channels.construct: energetic drive to detect flaws and improve or correct recurring patterns

channels.label: Synthesis
channels.construct: sensitivity to needs, belonging, principles, and the conditions required for social bonds

channels.label: Charisma
channels.construct: immediate manifestation of available sacral energy into action in the present

channels.label: Brainwave
channels.construct: spontaneous verbal or behavioral expression of immediate intuitive awareness

channels.label: Money
channels.construct: managing, controlling, and distributing material resources within a domain or group

channels.label: Structuring
channels.construct: translating unusual individual insight into a simple communicable formulation

channels.label: Awareness
channels.construct: persistent inner pressure to understand mysteries and rationalize private knowing

channels.label: Initiation
channels.construct: meeting challenge or shock in ways that initiate courage, spirit, or transformation

channels.label: Surrender
channels.construct: instinctive persuasion, promotion, memory for what works, and transmission of value

channels.label: Preservation
channels.construct: reliable care, protection, responsibility, and maintenance of shared values

channels.label: Struggle
channels.construct: fighting selectively for challenges that make life feel meaningful

channels.label: Discovery
channels.construct: committing to experience and discovering through sustained embodied participation

channels.label: Recognition
channels.construct: desire and imagination initiating emotionally significant experiences

channels.label: Transformation
channels.construct: ambition guided by instinct for what can endure and materially transform

channels.label: Power
channels.construct: immediate intuitive survival awareness backed by strong self-directed energy

channels.label: Transitoriness
channels.construct: moving through change, inexperience, emotional crisis, and new experience toward progress

channels.label: Community
channels.construct: reciprocal bargains of work, loyalty, friendship, family support, and rest

channels.label: Emoting
channels.construct: provocation and mood interacting with spirit, passion, and emotional abundance

channels.label: Maturation
channels.construct: starting, developing, and completing cycles so experience can mature

channels.label: Abstraction
channels.construct: processing confusing past impressions until they become coherent meaning or realization
